subject: Syndexa EFT rekey + portal ownership confirmation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@syndexa.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@syndexa.com
Date: 2027-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Change of bank (EFT re-key) and next steps for POs

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from Syndexa — we've completed a bank consolidation and need to update our remittance instructions on file with Redwood. We want to move EFT payments to our new operating account as of 2027-04-01.

Attached are our bank letter and ACH authorization for the new account: Syndexa_NewBank_Letter.pdf, Syndexa_ACH_Authorization.pdf.

Can you confirm what you need from our side to make this change? Specifically:
- Do you need a completed vendor update/onboarding form from us?
- Will existing open POs be updated to the new remittance, or do we need to issue credit memos/invoices?
- Is there any delay window where Redwood's next payment run may still hit the old account?

We're hoping for an expedited switch because a payroll vendor tied to our account is scheduled March 25 and we'd prefer the new routing to be in place for April invoices.

Thanks — attaching the documents as requested.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations
Syndexa Therapeutics
[Attachment: Syndexa_NewBank_Letter.pdf (PDF, 146KB)]
[Attachment: Syndexa_ACH_Authorization.pdf (PDF, 88KB)]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@syndexa.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Change of bank (EFT re-key) and next steps for POs

Liam — thanks for the note and attachments.

To make this change cleanly we need three things from Syndexa: 
1) Completed Redwood vendor update form (this replaces the onboarding packet for changes) — link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3SyndexaVendorOnboard — please upload the signed PDF.
2) W9 (or W-8 if applicable) — please attach the tax form you already have.
3) Copy of the bank letter / voided check (you included bank letter which is good; voided check helps for ACH).

Finance (cc Ben) and Procurement (cc Karthik) here's the proposed plan:
- Effective date requested by vendor: 2027-04-01.
- We will update vendor master and schedule the remap for the first AP cycle after the effective date.
- Open POs: we can update remittance for open POs that are not yet paid; invoices already paid cannot be reversed — vendor-side credits may be necessary.

Liam, can you complete the vendor update form and re-send the W9? Once we have that we can queue this for our next vendor master update. I'll also prepare the PO amendment DocuSign link if POs need to be reissued: https://app.docusign.com/PoAmendment/abc123

If you want expedited handling, note that our cut-off for the March 24 payment run is EOD March 22; anything after that will go into the April 1 cycle.

Thanks — I will follow up once Finance confirms the mapping.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Signature block]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@syndexa.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@syndexa.com
Date: 2027-03-19T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Change of bank (EFT re-key) and next steps for POs

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — attached: Syndexa_Vendor_Update_Form_filled.pdf and Syndexa_W9.pdf. I completed the vendor form and included the new account details on page 2.

A couple of clarifications:
- We would prefer the remittance to switch for all open POs with payment dates on/after 2027-04-01.
- For any invoices already submitted and unpaid, will Redwood automatically change the remittance on your side, or do we need to reissue those invoices referencing the new bank?
- Syndexa would appreciate an active test wire (small USD amount) once the remap is in place so we can confirm routing upstream.

Attached: Syndexa_Vendor_Update_Form_filled.pdf (PDF, 220KB), Syndexa_W9.pdf (PDF, 45KB).

Let me know if you need any additional certification documents.

Regards,
Liam
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@syndexa.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-20T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Change of bank (EFT re-key) and next steps for POs

Liam/Tessa — finance here. Appreciate the docs. Quick summary of how we'll process this: 

1) Vendor master update: once the vendor update form, W9 and bank letter are in the portal, we'll record the new remittance details and mark the effective date as 2027-04-01.
2) Open POs: for POs not yet paid we will update the remittance to the new bank automatically as part of the vendor master swap. For invoices already paid we cannot reverse payments — vendor-side credit memos are the correct route if funds were sent to the old account in error.
3) Cut-off and payment runs: the March 24 run will use the old routing; the first confirmed payment using the new routing will be in the April 7 run (our AP batch schedule lists 04/07 as the first post-effective run). Please plan accordingly.
4) International wires: if you plan to receive wires (not ACH), we'll need BIC/SWIFT and intermediary bank details. If the new account is USD-ACH only, confirm that.

We can do a test micro-wire/ACH ($1) upon request, but we need a security confirmation from the vendor (signed micro-deposit waiver). If you'd like, Tessa can send the DocuSign PO amendment and a portal-ownership confirmation checklist so we can close the loop on who has admin access to the vendor profile.

I've attached PO_change_template.csv to help map which POs should keep the old remittance vs which to move.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_change_template.csv (CSV, 2KB)]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@syndexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Request: Change of bank (EFT re-key) and next steps for POs

Thanks Ben/Tessa — that's helpful. We'll: 
- Confirm USD-ACH + provide SWIFT details if any wire transfers required.
- Return the signed micro-deposit waiver so you can process a $1 test if needed.
- Expect the first payment to hit new routing the week of 2027-04-07.

I'll keep accounts@syndexa.com in the loop. Please confirm once the portal ownership confirmation step is completed so we can remove the former accounts admin and add our new finance contact.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam
